title: Athena End To End Ai Agent
shortDescription: Production-Ready TTS Microservice (Supertonic ONNX) Architecture • Folder Structure • Deployment • Scaling • APIs • Best Practices Fully tuned for AI agent usage. What This Serv...
description:
Athena is an end-to-end desktop AI agent built on an Electron architecture that bridges a Vite-powered React frontend with local Node.js and Python microservices via Electron IPC. The user interface features an interactive 3D desktop widget powered by a custom Three.js rendering pipeline for VRM avatars and FBX animations. The visual interface incorporates WebGL context optimization and MediaPipe face tracking for realistic webcam-driven head movements, eye contact, and automated blinking.

Backend intelligence relies on a hybrid LLM strategy managed by a dynamic Model Router. System capabilities are mapped across cloud endpoints (such as Google Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro models) and local Ollama instances hosting models like dolphin-mistral and nomic-embed-text. The backend leverages LangGraph to orchestrate tool execution loops for local document RAG, web search, weather APIs, and timer actions. Extensibility is achieved through a custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) manager that handles stdio-based JSON-RPC sidecar process communication.

Voice interaction is delivered through a low-latency audio processing pipeline. Speech-to-Text (STT) is driven by a Python whisper-fast service operating on HTTP endpoint /stt, complemented by a Node.js SuperTonic Text-to-Speech (TTS) microservice on endpoint /tts. Real-time audio spectrum analysis maps voice frequencies directly to blendshapes on the 3D avatar mesh for procedural LipSync, supported by CPU throttling logic to keep idle overhead minimal.
myContributions: Architected a desktop microservice application using Electron IPC bridging a Vite React frontend and local background services.
Engineered a Model Router abstraction mapping role capabilities (planner, coder, vision, voice) to specific Gemini models or local Ollama instances.
Built a custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) manager to spawn, monitor, and handle stdio-based JSON-RPC sidecar processes.
Developed a Three.js rendering pipeline for VRM models and FBX animations optimized to maintain 60 FPS performance.
Implemented MediaPipe face and head tracking enabling the 3D VRM assistant to respond to webcam inputs in real time.
Devised mathematical LipSync mapping audio frequencies directly to avatar mouth blendshapes with minimal CPU overhead.
Engineered GPU enforcer settings for WebGL and deepDispose algorithms for FBX memory management to prevent memory leaks.
Integrated a Python whisper-fast STT service running on port 9001 with connection retries and ECONNREFUSED error handling.
Configured a Node.js SuperTonic TTS service exposed via REST endpoints (/tts and /health) on port 3000.
Orchestrated tool execution using LangGraph to enable web search, weather queries, local timer controls, and document RAG.
Created centralized backend configuration for LLM timeouts, STT timeouts, retry strategy, and model fallback settings.
Leveraged Docker and ONNX Runtime support for efficient background machine learning execution.

features: 3D VRM avatar desktop widget with FBX animation support.
MediaPipe webcam integration for real-time face tracking, blinking, and eye contact.
Local zero-latency STT voice input powered by a Python whisper-fast microservice.
Fast local TTS voice synthesis via Node.js SuperTonic microservice.
Flexible LLM execution supporting both cloud Gemini APIs and local Ollama models.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) sidecar process manager for modular tool extensions.
LangGraph tool orchestration engine supporting RAG, weather, timers, and search.
Frequency-driven procedural LipSync math with idle CPU throttling.
Resilient service connection management with automated backoff retries for STT.
challenges: Balancing GPU resource allocation between Three.js 60 FPS rendering and local ONNX/Ollama inference tasks.
Handling stdio line buffering and non-blocking asynchronous JSON-RPC parsing in the MCP sidecar manager.
Managing race conditions during startup when Node.js services connect to the Python whisper-fast STT server.
Minimizing CPU overhead caused by continuous audio frequency analysis and real-time VRM mesh morph updates.
Preventing VRAM memory leaks during continuous FBX animation switching using explicit deep disposal pipelines.
learnings: Design patterns for IPC communication between Electron main process, React renderer, and background sidecars.
Strategies for resilient stream parsing of stdio JSON-RPC channels in Node.js child process management.
Optimization techniques for WebGL contexts and memory lifecycle management in Three.js VRM applications.
Role-based model routing patterns to optimize latency and cost between cloud LLMs and local models.
Audio frequency processing methods for procedural mouth blendshape mapping in web applications.
architectureOverview: Frontend built with React, TailwindCSS. Backend API powered by WebSockets, Express, FastAPI. AI/ML capabilities powered by ONNX Runtime. Deployed using Docker.
userFlow: User accesses application user interface via browser
User triggers action invoking HTTP/WebSocket API endpoints
Payload processed through AI/ML pipeline or local inference model
codeFlow: Client or caller initiates request to application entrypoint
Backend router validates request parameters and applies middleware
Service layer delegates task to ML runtime or LLM API worker
Application serializes JSON/audio/data response back to client

remotionVideoScript.voiceoverScript: Welcome to the technical breakdown of athena-end-to-end-ai-agent, a production-grade application engineered with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python. System Architecture & Topology: The application uses a decoupled multi-tier architecture powered by WebSockets, Express, FastAPI on the backend and React, TailwindCSS on the client. Network Routes: The API exposes 4 primary routes including GET /health and POST /tts and GET /status, managing request routing and data serialization. AI Capabilities: Powered by ONNX Runtime, delivering real-time inference and intelligent processing. Performance & Quality: Automated quality checks and clean component patterns ensure high reliability. Explore the full open-source codebase on GitHub at Sameer-Bagul slash athena-end-to-end-ai-agent.
